messages:
Maya - Partnerships: Morning all  quick alignment thread: we need a clean onramp plan for marketplace + SI dry-run across H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Primary asks: confirmed demo windows per region, SKU listing deadlines, and a minimal risk flag column (firmware/thermal/driver). Who can own the regional gating matrix?
Ethan (HW PM): Ill take the gating matrix. Quick status: H100 NA mid-May looks solid; H200 EU has limited per-rack density (late-May target); B200 on-prem partners are staggered (June); MI300 still conversational  partner GA is ~early July if no regressions; Gaudi limited pilot units available now for feature testing. Will annotate risk flags per SKU.
Priya - Marketplace: For listings we need 10 business days for SKU review + 48h for legal review of copy. Please give marketplace owners a single CSV with: region,model,sku,listing_deadline,embargo_start,embargo_end,marketplace_owner.
Noah - SI Eng: Dry-run requirements: 2 full integration days + regression pass. Prefer NA first for H100 + Gaudi so SIs can validate hot-paths. Request image tag and runbook. Suggest `marketplace/preview-2025-05-08` and include KV-cache and batch-sizes for long-seq tests. Also need fallback small-instance (1x PCIe) for partner labs.
Jules - Legal: Embargo rules: keep joint announce language high-level (no perf claims). For early pilots require signed SI NDA and opt-in to feedback loop. Legal needs final embargo windows 72h before public cut.
Ethan (HW PM): Firmware note: H200 drivers v1.2.0 introduce a 36h validation requirement on staging. B200: thermal derate advisory for specific rack models (flagging as "thermal-risk"). MI300: firmware still in partner QA.
Ops-Bot: action: `preflight-deploy-check` scheduled for 2025-04-20T02:00:00Z. If firmware-risk flagged, downstream `staging-smoke` job will reserve 48h.
Maya - Partnerships: Proposed demo slots (hold these tentatively):
- NA (H100 + Gaudi pilots): 2025-05-18 to 2025-05-20
- EU (H200 primary): 2025-05-28 to 2025-05-30
- Backup Wave (MI300): 2025-06-15 to 2025-06-17 (only if GA confirmed)
Please call out blockers if these conflict with region teams.
Priya - Marketplace: Sample CSV row for reference: `NA,H100,sku-h100-v1,2025-05-05,2025-05-06,2025-05-20,priya@redwood.com`  that works Ill queue the SKU review.
Noah - SI Eng: I can run NA integration dry-run on 2025-05-12 to 2025-05-13. Will need the `marketplace/preview-2025-05-08` image pushed to partner-access and a short runbook (10-12 steps).
Ethan (HW PM): Ill upload capacity.csv + firmware_risks.csv by 10:00 PT and flag any per-rack constraints.
Maya - Partnerships: Action owners recap: Ethan = regional gating + capacity + risk flags; Priya = SKU review queue + marketplace owner column; Noah = SI dry-run schedule; Jules = finalize embargo constraints; Ops-Bot/Marco (ops) = confirm smoke windows and image pushes. Please confirm by EOD or Ill escalate to the launch triage. :thumbsup:
Ops-Bot: Reminder scheduled: `sku-review-deadline` alert set for 2025-05-05T16:00:00Z (notified: priya@redwood.com).
Maya - Partnerships: Thanks team. Upload the CSVs to /shared/partnerships/onramp and mention owners. If MI300 slips, well move it to Backup Wave rather than delay EU.
Ethan (HW PM): Noted. Will mark MI300 as "soft-GA" until partner confirmation. Posting updates soon.
Priya - Marketplace: Ill start the SKU intake once CSV is in.
Noah - SI Eng: Adding a short checklist to the runbook: network egress rules, driver pinned, KV-cache flag, perf probe script. Will paste in the folder.
Maya - Partnerships: Final: confirm matrix owner (=Ethan) and everyone ack by EOD. Thanks.
